list.name: tz
list.label: Timezone
list.description: IANA timezone used for daily boundaries (e.g. Europe/Vienna). Should match your browser/dashboard timezone.

list.name: price_buy
list.label: Grid price per kWh
list.description: Price you pay per kWh drawn from the grid. A MetricsQL expression is allowed, e.g. (0.35 * (time() < bool 1772319600) + 0.25 * (time() >= bool 1772319600)) for a price change on 2026-03-01.

list.name: price_sell
list.label: Feed-in tariff per kWh
list.description: Compensation you receive per kWh fed into the grid. MetricsQL expressions allowed (see price_buy).
